lena (AE): Heads-up: GreenCart asks for a 48h POC. Requirements: browser streaming, inventory function calls, and strict JSON events for ETL. Price sensitive and wants SOC2/KMS info. Who can lead tech?
omar (SE): I'll lead. Need to know SSE vs websocket — they prefer zero-install browser demo, so SSE+poll fallback works.
rachel (Eng): Function calls over SSE okay. We'll demo function_call name 'check_inventory' returning a validated JSON.
devex-bot: I'll prepare node SSE sample + python consumer and include schema: {"order_id":"string","items":[{"sku":"string","qty":1}],"total_cents":1000} and a small canary test.
security-bot: Received questionnaire — EU data residency, KMS, log retention flagged. Provide SOC2 stub and recommend EU-only region for POC.
legal: Can produce a POC addendum in 48h; confirm no real PII in test data.
lena (AE): Sales wants a rough per-checkout anchor for kickoff. Omar/Rachel please give ballpark by EOD.
omar (SE): Napkin: ~320 tokens/checkout. For 100 TPS spikes, hosted cost large; recommend short dedicated dev pool. I'll post options.
rachel (Eng): I'll add quantized model option to reduce token spend and a runbook for schema enforcement.
lena (AE): Great. Action items: omar runbook + estimate, rachel model config, devex sample repos. Kickoff Thurs 10am CET. :thumbsup:
